attributes.storage_instructions: Airtight Container: Keep sealed in the original jar to preserve crunch. Cool & Dry: Store away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture. Refrigerate: Best stored in the fridge to maintain freshness longer. Avoid Moisture: Always use dry hands or a dry spoon.

nova_group derived here, not read from a source. Computed from the ingredient list already on this record by the NOVA method (Monteiro et al.), using the marker lists Open Food Facts publishes for its own implementation. Only groups 1 and 4 are written: on a held-out half of the 4,107 records carrying an Open Food Facts NOVA value, this method reaches 96.5% precision on group 1 and 98.1% on group 4, while groups 2 and 3 could not be separated from each other above 51% and are left null.

nova_group derived here, not read from a source. Computed from the ingredient list already on this record by the NOVA method (Monteiro et al.), using the marker lists Open Food Facts publishes for its own implementation. Only groups 1 and 4 are ever written: measured on a held-out half (n=8,277) of the 16,554 grocery records that carry both an Open Food Facts NOVA value and an ingredient list, this method reaches 99.6% precision on group 1 and 99.7% on group 4. Groups 2 and 3 are left null because they could not be separated from each other above 51%, and a wrong 'processed' on an ultra-processed food is the error that misleads a reader. A medicine, a cosmetic and a concentrated ratio-extract are refused outright: NOVA classifies foods.
